subject: Lane D Cycle 2 DESIGN: controlled cold-first vs later-open reproduction matrix
body: Paired attempts with one-variable-at-a-time interpretation. Mandatory baseline is first opening versus immediate subsequent opening with processEpoch recorded. Bounded controls distinguish app-cold, dependency-cold, cache-miss, display-remap and later-process recovery.

matrix.setup: Normal field start; begin trace before accepted opening edge.
matrix.purpose: Capture actual failure path without preconditioning.
matrix.required: processEpoch/serviceEpoch/attemptId + complete gate trace + terminal/death marker.

matrix.setup: No force-stop; retain same process if alive.
matrix.action: Immediate second opening after stable closed/native-cover state.
matrix.purpose: Determine whether later success is truly same-process and first differing state.

matrix.setup: Wait only for explicit dependency-ready receipts, not arbitrary sleep.
matrix.purpose: Test dependency readiness vs attempt count.

matrix.setup: Restart only app process while Shizuku is already running and accessibility enabled.
matrix.action: First opening in new app process.
matrix.purpose: Separate app-cold state from external dependency warm state.

matrix.setup: Debug-only if approved: force SnapshotCache MISS without changing route/wake/hinge semantics.
matrix.purpose: Falsify/confirm cache-miss association independently of global cold start.

matrix.setup: Debug-only if approved: known-current cache HIT from same provenance contract.

pairwise_interpretation: R1 fail + R2 success, same process/service: compare first divergent event.
R1 fail + R2 success, different process: cross-process recovery, not same-process warm success.
R5 fail + R6 success with equal dependencies: strong cache-branch evidence but terminal trace still locates exact failure.
R5 and R6 both succeed: weakens cache-miss crash hypothesis.
Both fail same gate: record contradiction; do not force fit.
